name: claude-eloquent
description: Keeps Claude's comments terse. A PreToolUse hook measures how much of every Edit/Write/MultiEdit is comment and bounces an over-commented edit back once with rewrite guidance; an identical resubmit is accepted. Heuristics only, no external API calls.

disabled.title: Disable claude-eloquent
disabled.description: Set to true to disable comment checking entirely

comment_ratio.title: Comment ratio threshold
comment_ratio.description: Deny an edit when comment characters exceed this fraction of the edited text. Default is 0.40

min_chars.title: Minimum edit size
min_chars.description: Skip the ratio check for edits smaller than this many characters, so a small edit with one comment never trips it. Default is 200

check_block_lines.title: Check comment block length
check_block_lines.description: Also deny when any single contiguous comment block exceeds max_block_lines. Off by default

max_block_lines.title: Maximum comment block lines
max_block_lines.description: Longest allowed contiguous comment block when check_block_lines is on. Default is 6

session_context.title: Inject session guidance
session_context.description: Add a short comment-style instruction at session start so denials stay rare. Default is true

allow_on_retry.title: Allow identical resubmits
allow_on_retry.description: Accept an edit that is resubmitted unchanged after a denial, on the basis that the model judged the comments necessary. Turn off to deny every time. Default is true
